about: Known-good metrics (root CLAUDE.md, Metrics and baselines). Update a value only when the owner confirms the change is intended.
journeys_about: Magic-moment journeys (X8, packages/testing/src/magic.ts): the most clicks and the slowest of 5 walks in Chromium on GitHub's ubuntu-latest runners, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-16; re-measured that day as the slowest of 12 five-walk runs on 4 runners (0.19-1.23 s). apps/fission/e2e/journeys.mjs fails on any extra click (every run) and, nightly (JOURNEY_NIGHTLY=1), on a slowest walk more than 15% over.
